title: [WIP] Add examples for currently defined protocols
body:
## Create Examples for Missing Protocol Categories

### Analysis Complete
- [x] Analyze all 57 protocol schemas across 11 categories
- [x] Identify existing examples (only UI protocols have examples)
- [x] Understand example structure pattern

### Protocols with Examples ✅
- [x] UI (8/8 protocols - COMPLETE): action, app, dashboard, page, theme, view, report, widget
  - [x] Added report.examples.ts (12 examples)
  - [x] Added widget.examples.ts (20 examples)
  - [x] Fixed all filter structures to use MongoDB-style operators ($eq, $ne, $gte, $and, $or)
- [x] Data (8/8 protocols - COMPLETE): dataset, field, filter, hook, mapping, object, query, validation
  - [x] Created examples/data/metadata-examples/
  - [x] Added field.examples.ts (36 examples)
  - [x] Added object.examples.ts (10 examples)
  - [x] Added query.examples.ts (25 examples)
  - [x] Added filter.examples.ts (27 examples)
  - [x] Added validation.examples.ts (20 examples)
  - [x] Added hook.examples.ts (20 examples)
  - [x] Added mapping.examples.ts (10 examples)
  - [x] Added dataset.examples.ts (10 examples)
  - [x] Fixed mapping mode from 'replace' to 'upsert'
  - [x] Added package.json, tsconfig.json, README.md, index.ts

### Protocols Needing Examples 📝
- [ ] AI (8 protocols): agent, conversation, cost, model-registry, nlq, orchestration, predictive, rag-pipeline
- [ ] API (5 protocols): contract, discovery, endpoint, realtime, router  
- [ ] Auth (5 protocols): config, identity, organization, policy, role
- [ ] Automation (3 protocols): flow, webhook, workflow
- [ ] Driver (4 protocols): datasource, driver, mongo, postgres
- [ ] Hub (5 protocols): composer, license, marketplace, space, tenant
- [ ] Kernel (5 protocols): context, logger, manifest, plugin, scoped-storage
- [ ] Permission (3 protocols): permission, sharing, territory
- [ ] System (4 protocols): audit, events, job, translation

### Plan
- [x] Complete UI category (8/8 protocols)
- [x] Create Data category examples (8/8 protocols) - 158 examples
- [x] Fix all code review issues
- [ ] Create Automation category examples folder
